rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when meaning or information depends on the surrounding words or text.

example.english: The meaning of this character is contextual and can only be judged from the surrounding text.
example.traditional: 呢個字嘅意思要視乎語境先至判斷到。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zi6 ge3 ji3 si1 jiu3 si6 fu4 jyu5 ging2 sin1 zi3 pun3 dyun6 dou2

rows.note: Use this when the meaning or relevance depends on the surrounding situation rather than specifically on surrounding text.

example.english: Whether we need to reschedule is contextual and depends on the situation.
example.traditional: 係咪要改期，要視乎情況。
example.jyutping: hai6 mai6 jiu3 goi2 kei4 jiu3 si6 fu4 cing4 fong3
